description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horethuduwa, Panadura D/S Division,  Kaluthara District   - Cad. Map No.  530011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration details, ownership information, extent, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, specifically title registration and settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
